title: 日本学（日本と日本人）Ａ
subtitle: Japanology (Japan and Japanese)A
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesCharacter Building
teachers:
MURAMOTO Miharu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn about the life of the founders of Japan and how to live and think.
(2) Understand the characteristics and national character of Japan.
(3) Learn about various world and Japanese founding myths.
(4) Understand that there are various ways of thinking about the world.
(5) Improve their basic reading, listening, thinking, and writing skills.
advice:
This course will teach the Japanese way of life and thinking by covering the following:
1. Japanese way of life and thinking
2. Japanese national character
3. Japanese mythology
4. Various myths around the world
5. Japanese founding myth

Students are required to participate actively in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbooks, handouts, and other necessary materials to every class.
Students must read and prepare to discuss the designated text pages.
Students are required to understand the content of the lectures and to write using appropriate Japanese terminology.
Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class.
books: Textbooks： Reference books：The Story of Japan, Vols. I-III (Seisei kikaku) Reserved books：None
requiredKnowledge:
Ability to read preparatory text correctly.
Ability to prepare and have a comprehensive understanding of the lecture content.
Ability to think about the instructed theme and write about the results using appropriate Japanese terminology.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the Japanese way of life and thinking using appropriate Japanese term.
Be able to explain the Japanese national character using appropriate Japanese term.
Be able to read about the characteristics of Japanese myths and explain them using appropriate Japanese term.
Be able to explain the founding of Japan using appropriate Japanese term.
Be able to self-assess one’s own goals in this class.
